neighbours.label: an opening quotation mark or clause-break punctuation starting a new quoted or cited segment
fire: The doctor shook her head. “Rest is the only cure for this,” she said.
He paused, then continued: “Whether we win or lose, we play fair.”
The sign by the door read: “No dogs allowed after six.”
After a long silence the old man spoke. “I remember that winter well.”
My teacher wrote in the margin: “Good idea, but explain it more.”
She looked up from the map. “We should turn left at the river.”
The captain raised his glass and said: “To the crew, and safe seas.”
The letter ended simply. “Come home soon, we miss you.”
